title: Stock Market Today Highlights, Nov 9: Stock markets end higher amid easing crude oil prices, buying in banks - The HinduBusinessLine
text:

Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Highlights: The 30-share BSE Sensex climbed 107.25 points, or 0.13%, to settle at 81,106.65. The 50-share NSE Nifty rose 58.25 points, or 0.23%, to close at 25,044.65.

In the 30 Sensex firms, State Bank of India, Trent, Larsen & Toubro, NTPC, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank were among the major winners. In contrast, HCL Tech, Tata Steel, UltraTech Cement and Bajaj Finance were among the major laggards.

Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, declined 1.04% to $97.46 per barrel. Rupee rises 5 paise to close at 93.93 (provisional) against US dollar.

Rupee ends six-session rally as state banks’ dollar bids offset gains, with RBI considerations and global cues shaping next moves.

Ramkrishna Forgings-Titagarh Rail JV in Tamil Nadu aims full capacity by FY30, targeting global exports and Asia’s second-largest forged wheels plant.

Infrastructure major Larsen & Toubro (L&T) on Monday said it has secured an order ranging between Rs 1,000 crore and Rs 2,500 crore from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.

The Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical of L&T has secured an order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd for part design and construction of the Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Project.

The project scope encompasses part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector-142, and from Depot Station to Boraki. The scope includes the construction of 10 elevated metro stations, including architectural finishes.

Paras Semiconductors, a subsidiary of Paras Defence & Space Technologies Limited, announced a strategic technology partnership with BroadPak Corporation, USA, to accelerate the development of advanced semiconductor packaging capabilities in India. The collaboration will combine Paras’s manufacturing ambitions in Opto-electronics, photonics and copackaged optics high with BroadPak’s specialised technology expertise in advanced semiconductor packaging, heterogeneous integration and chiplet-based system architectures.

Bank of Baroda, India’s International Bank, today inaugurated its new Head Office and Georgetown Branch in Guyana, along with the Bank of Baroda Heritage Centre, showcasing the Bank’s rich legacy and its longstanding association with the country. The Bank started operations in Guyana on March 31, 1966, nearly two months before Guyana attained independence. In 1999, its local operations were converted into a wholly owned subsidiary, Bank of Baroda (Guyana) Inc. Today, the Bank operates two branches in the country and remains the only Indian bank with a presence in Guyana.

National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) has deployed a Direct-to-Chip Liquid Cooling (DCLC) solution to support its growing artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. The deployment is a first-of-its-kind deployment in Indian capital markets and reflects NSE’s continued focus on building scalable, resilient and future-ready technology infrastructure to support emerging compute-intensive workloads.

As NSE expands AI use cases across the organization, the new infrastructure enables deployment of high-density GPU-based computing through an efficient and scalable cooling architecture. NSE has already deployed multiple GPUs and plans to expand the environment to more than 80 GPUs during the current quarter. The DCLC infrastructure has been designed with capacity to scale up to 224 GPUs across high-density racks, aligned with future AI computing requirements.

BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited (‘BlueStone’), a leading digital first, direct-to-consumer jewellery brand, is pleased to report provisional business update on its performance for quarter till date (QTD: 1-Oct to 8-Nov) of Q3 FY27 over same period last year.

The growth momentum continued into the quarter as the Company recorded a 45% YoY business growth for the said period which includes the festive period particularly Dhanteras and Diwali. This growth was largely buyer transaction driven with average realisations being the same as last year (comparable period).

SEBI approves MakeMyTrip India’s IPO plan, enabling a sale of MMT India shares by parent MakeMyTrip and ibibo Group, with proceeds boosting growth and cash reserves.

Indian oilmeal exports declined 36 per cent in August due to pricing pressures in international markets.

Phoenix Kothari Ltd alloted 450 million shares to Kothari Industrial in November 2026, increasing its stake to 30%. The acquisition, part of growth strategy, involved nil turnover in FY 2025-26, with no regulatory approvals needed. The target firm operates in footwear manufacturing, with a history of stable, low turnover, focused on strengthening the company’s presence in the footwear industry.

PhysicsWallah reported strong Q2 FY2027 growth with revenue of ₹1242 crores, up 18%, profit doubling to ₹142 crores, and EBITDA rising 45%. Key drivers include increased enrollments, higher ARPU, and AI-driven expansion into vernacular and South India markets. Strategic initiatives include launching NEET crash courses, digital university approvals, M&A pipeline, and asset-light capital allocation, focusing on sustainable long-term growth.

Nasdaq-listed travel booking platform MakeMyTrip’s India subsidiary has received Sebi’s approval to launch an initial public offering (IPO), according to an update available on the markets regulator’s website on Monday.

MakeMyTrip (India) Ltd (MMT India) had filed draft papers with Sebi in July through the confidential route. After examining the draft documents, the regulator issued its final observations on November 6. (PTI)

The three companies are competing for the Outer Harbour infrastructure contract at Thoothukudi port, which will be executed under the Hybrid Annuity Model.
